facts.text: On the ground and in the saddle

philosophy.title: Slow down, feel, find your centre again
philosophy.lead: Horses of Florence was born in the heart of the Florentine Chianti from a simple idea: time spent with a horse can become a way back to yourself.
paragraphs: A horse lives in the present and responds to who we truly are, not to who we would like to appear. Beside a horse, we learn to listen again: to our breath, our body, our emotions.

We bring together the beauty of the Florentine countryside, with its vineyards, olive groves and stone villages, and the depth of the bond with the animal. An invitation to pause, to feel and to find your balance again.
philosophy.quote: The horse is not just a companion, but a guide.

pillars.title: Slow down
pillars.text: Leave the rush behind and find the rhythm of the walk, of your breath, of nature.

pillars.title: Feel
pillars.text: Notice what the horse perceives, and what you perceive through the horse.

pillars.title: Find your centre
pillars.text: Go home lighter, with new energy and a clearer view of yourself.

band.quote: Every encounter with a horse is a journey: towards the horse, and towards yourself.
band.caption: Horses of Florence

for_you.title: A welcome made to measure
for_you.intro: We welcome no more than one to three riders at a time, so that the instructor can take care of even the smallest details. You choose the pace: we take care of the rest.
for_you.riders_label: riders at a time, at most

features.title: Individually or in small groups
features.text: One to three riders at a time: full attention, tailored to each person.

features.title: Our horses or your own
features.text: Work with the centre’s horses or with your own companion, who can be stabled at our partner centre.

features.title: A FISE centre
features.text: Our partner riding centre is affiliated with the Italian Equestrian Sports Federation (FISE), with qualified staff.

features.title: Stay in the Chianti
features.text: Stay at the B&B and live your holiday, or your free time, as a journey towards yourself.

paths.kicker: On the ground and in the saddle
paths.title: Two paths, one harmony
paths.intro: We work with the horses both on the ground and in the saddle, with two main aims.

items.label: For you and your horse
items.title: Improve the bond with your horse
items.text: To get to know your horse more deeply, communicate more clearly and strengthen the bond with your companion in life or at work.

items.label: For you
items.title: Find yourself again
items.text: To move past emotional blocks, find yourself again, regenerate and recharge, at the slow pace of the Tuscan countryside.

experiences.title: Beyond your time with the horses
experiences.intro: The Florentine Chianti invites you to explore. Around the B&B, gravel roads, footpaths and flavours make every stay unique.

items.title: Fortified villages and castles
items.text: Small stone villages, ancient walls and castles on the hills: the most authentic Tuscany, close at hand.

items.title: Florence, Siena and beyond
items.text: The cities of art and other destinations, some just half an hour away.

items.title: By bike or on foot along the Pesa
items.text: From the B&B to Cerbaia in Val di Pesa, along the cycle path that follows the stream. Bikes available to hire.

items.title: Pool, padel and fishing
items.text: For an afternoon of sport or pure relaxation, near the B&B.

items.title: Local olive oil and wine
items.text: Olive oil and wine tastings at local producers.

stay.title: A home among the hills
paragraphs: To enjoy the experience without hurrying, you can stay at the B&B A spasso con Daisy · Chianti Home: two apartments in Barberino Tavarnelle, in the heart of the Chianti, a short walk from the Pesa stream.
A holiday, or even just a weekend, to live as a journey towards yourself.
stay.note: The B&B website opens in a new tab.

items.title: The three gaits
items.text: You should be confident at the three gaits: walk, trot and canter.

items.title: Suitable clothing
items.text: Wear clothing suitable for riding: comfortable, safe and made for the saddle.

apparel.title: Wear our philosophy
apparel.text: A clothing line in the colours of the project, so you can carry a little of this harmony with you, even far from the stables.

contact.title: Don’t wait until tomorrow to take care of yourself, of each other.
contact.intro: Tell us who you are, whether you will come with your own horse and what you are looking for: we will reply to shape your experience together.
